lenses.verdict: On the path and wall pages the round works: right after the button I see this product, in its place, at night, under a heading I read in one glance, and I am more ready to press. The rope page is blocked — its new photograph carries a baked «עמידות IP65 / מתאימות לשימוש חוץ» badge (the pre-crop missed it), so a sales page shows baked text and an IP claim that the facts print again 500 px lower. The two pages without a photograph (flood, deck) get a caption-scale heading with nothing under it, and the deck page's caption names the wrong place («על השביל» for a stair light). The copy leans on «בלילה» (four times in 290 px on flood) and the dusk row's second sentence tells me what the not-for line told me a screen earlier. Nothing new delays the button badly; the guide link is the only exit, drawn identically to the contact promise.

The path and wall pages are what I asked for: my own product, at night, page-wide, one heading, one sentence, one link, and nothing else — simple. But the rope page ships a baked «עמידות IP65» badge inside the photograph at 390 (the exact thing I said never to do), twelve of my 27 products get an image-led section with no image, and the sun dependency is now said twice on every solar page. Fix the rope asset before this goes anywhere near the live theme; the rest is tuning.

Not shippable as deployed. The copy is clean on all 27 products (the solar gate reproduces the inventory's 16/11 exactly, every product sits in one of the four collections, the SPEC §2 sentences are byte-identical on the mirrors) and 15 of the 18 assets are what the ledger says they are - but one of the five verified pages, the rope PDP, shows a baked «עמידות IP65 · מתאימות לשימוש חוץ» badge inside the scene photograph at 390 and 360: a spec printed twice, baked text, and the exact thing SPEC §3 says gets a frame rejected. Two more pre-crops left remnants (a person's legs on the powerful bollard, a headline stroke on the step light), and one heading places a camping lantern «בגינה». Re-cut three files and add one map override and this is honest.

The photograph-led state on path and wall is the best-crafted thing on the page: edge-to-edge, no scrim, the place heading under it at the related grid's scale, one line, one link — restraint that holds at 390, 360 and 1366. But the rope page (one of the five acceptance pages) ships a baked «עמידות IP65» pill inside the photograph at 390 and 360 — the pre-crop in SPEC §3 removed the icon, not the badge — which is a text-on-the-photograph and honesty fail that only the desktop band happens to hide. Below the photograph the craft loosens: the «כשמחשיך» row is glued to the scene text (28 px) and floats 80–130 px above the facts it was meant to rhyme with, its two sentences wrap mid-sentence at every width (an orphan «בלילה.» at 1366), and on flood/deck the text-only scene reads as a stub between two identical arrow links rather than a designed row. Fix the rope asset and the two rows below the photograph and this is an 8.

The two sections are engineered as specified: the solar gate is right on all five archetypes (wall prints no dusk row, the others do), the 15-handle map matches CHOSEN.md byte for byte in sizes and crops, srcset candidates never exceed the file, width/height/lazy/decoding are on the img, the guide link renders exactly once per page at /pages/guide-garden-lighting, every §11 count is unchanged on all 30 renders, no Liquid error, no overflow-x, section heights under every cap, lint clean. Two things fail on the real render: the rope frame still carries the baked «עמידות IP65 / מתאימה לשימוש חוץ» badge (the pre-crop cut the wrong band) and it is fully visible at 390/360, and three assets are over the 220 KB budget with a 281 KB mobile derivative on the path page. One dormant code path (scene_fallback) can show a sibling's photo without the credit line.
